question: Validate proof-assisted standard leading-syzygy first-fall degrees and explicit factored witnesses on all16 retained prime inputs; distinguish earliest new affine fall.

claims.text: Standard leading-syzygy first-fall degree is floor(ell/2)+4 by the written filtered Koszul argument and endpoint annihilator. Lower bound is proof-assisted, not full n83 matrix measurement; full Lean formalization remains open.
Native code checks hypotheses, original input presentation, pair identities, nonzero affine products and fresh-process certificate consistency for every retained prime input.
Earliest NEW affine fall, last fall, regularity, performance and ECDLP remain unestablished by this stage.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact finite-field computations, two pivot orders and fresh-process witness replay; no timing or statistical comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Five exact small-matrix controls over65537 at (ell,m)=(2,4),(3,3),(4,3),(5,2),(6,2) must detect the first kernel at5,5,6,6,7. All degrees are below8, so no quartic Koszul boundaries can create false positives.

negative.not_applicable_reason: All preceding degree matrices in the same controls must have zero kernel. Pair identity uses minus then plus; minus squared must remain nonzero. Wide modular multiplication is separately tested.
